decisions.statement: The signed text is the timestamp and the raw body joined by a bar.
A signature older than the tolerance is refused however well that signature verifies.
The tolerance is five minutes where no tolerance is given.
A clock ahead of the signer is tolerated as far as a clock behind the signer.
The base64 spelling of bytes is here for any caller that needs that spelling.

definition: whether an inbound webhook truly came from Telnyx
